content.short: Credshields provides Web3 security and auditing.
content.description: Credshields is a Web3 security company that provides manual auditing of smart contracts and security assessments of Web2 infrastructure. It also builds next-generation security tools for Web3, including SolidityScan, an automated auditing and vulnerability scanning platform for Solidity-based smart contracts. By combining thorough manual reviews with innovative tooling, Credshields helps projects identify weaknesses, strengthen security posture, and safeguard deployments across supported chains. Its services cover multiple ecosystems and align with best practices to mitigate risk.
content.meta: Credshields offers security services, auditing for smart contracts. Discover Credshields and other Web3 Security Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
